hypothesis: The pinned official Zipformer pipeline produces a valid manifest on RTX 4070.
exact_change: Baseline; batch_size=1, one warm-up sample, two evaluation samples.
wer_scope: official normalized diagnostic subset, not full-set WER
conclusion: Pipeline and official scorer agree on the manifest contract; the runner convenience WER of 2.89 is not the leaderboard metric.

hypothesis: Larger inference batches improve throughput without changing decoded text.
exact_change: Only batch_size changed from 1 to 8; 16 evaluation samples and eight warm-up samples.
wer_scope: first two overlapping rows only; identical references and predictions
conclusion: Throughput improved and the overlapping decoded text was unchanged.

hypothesis: Batch 32 remains within 12 GB and improves throughput over batch 8.
exact_change: Only batch_size changed from 8 to 32; 64 evaluation samples and 32 warm-up samples.
wer_scope: first two overlapping rows only; identical references and predictions
conclusion: The diagnostic fit the RTX 4070; full-set throughput must still be measured because sample lengths vary.

hypothesis: The pinned Zipformer pipeline reproduces a competitive full-set official score locally.
exact_change: Expanded the kept batch-32 configuration from 64 rows to all 2620 test.clean rows; no model or decoding change.
wer_scope: official normalized full public test.clean set
conclusion: The official score is 1.31 WER. The runner convenience metric was 1.67 and must not be reported as leaderboard WER.

hypothesis: The kept pinned baseline can score accented parliamentary speech without changing decoding.
exact_change: Only the dataset changed from librispeech/test.clean to voxpopuli_cleaned_aa/test; batch_size remained 32.
conclusion: The official WER is 4.31. Long variable-length rows reduced throughput; wall and peak metrics were not retained after a detached duplicate-run recovery.

hypothesis: The kept pinned baseline can score long-form financial speech within RTX 4070 memory without changing decoding.
exact_change: Only the dataset and safety batch size changed from voxpopuli_cleaned_aa/test at batch 32 to earnings22/test at batch 16; model and beam-6 decoding remained pinned.
dataset: earnings22/test all 2737 officially evaluable rows from 2741 raw rows at b6bdcd0beb34f8975dc659796176d88f43aff502
conclusion: The official WER is 7.68. Financial and long-form speech is the hardest completed domain so far; substitutions dominate, with deletion and insertion counts also substantial.

hypothesis: The pinned baseline retains competitive accuracy on noisier read speech with the safe batch-16 configuration.
exact_change: Only the dataset changed from earnings22/test to librispeech/test.other; model, beam-6 decoding, and batch size 16 remained fixed.
conclusion: The official WER is 3.01. Substitutions dominate and the result is 1.70 points worse than test.clean without changing the model or decoder.

hypothesis: The pinned baseline can score cleaned meeting speech within RTX 4070 memory without changing decoding.
exact_change: Only the dataset changed from librispeech/test.other to ami_cleaned/test; model, beam-6 decoding, and batch size 16 remained fixed.
dataset: ami_cleaned/test all 7715 officially evaluable rows from 7805 raw rows at b6bdcd0beb34f8975dc659796176d88f43aff502
conclusion: The official WER is 10.30. Meeting speech is the hardest completed domain; utterance-level analysis is required before attributing errors to overlap, disfluencies, names, or acoustics.

hypothesis: Pinned Zipformer decoding is stable across independent runs and batch sizes.
exact_change: Compared the tracked batch-1 two-row diagnostic with the same rows from the independent batch-32 full run; excluded run-dependent timing.
conclusion: Audio identities, durations, references, and predictions are byte-equivalent across the two runs; timing differs as expected.
